title: TCAQ - Breakfast with Santa

sections.heading: Breakfast with Santa
sections.markdown:
Join The Clubs at Quantico for a delicious and expansive breakfast buffet with omelette station.

Santa will be in attendance and available for photos.

Two seatings are available: 9:00 AM and 10:30 AM.

Adult Reservations (13+) $30/adult
Child Reservations (4-12yrs) $15/child
Children 3 years & under are FREE

**Please note:** All ticket purchases are subject to Eventbrite service and processing fees. These fees are visible before checkout – displayed alongside ticket prices – and are non-refundable.

Click here to get [TICKETS ON EVENTBRITE](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/1999385072574?aff=oddtdtcreator)
